shots.why: Frame 0: the base town at night, every base glowing its egg colour, kids sprinting between them.

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: The hero, empty-handed, watching the thieves: face by 5 s.
The rule as one picture: the clock at 11:59.
Every kid has a base: the Ember base, its egg glowing in the nest.
Every base has a nest: the Frost base.
Grab an egg. Run: behind a runner leaving the Sprinkle base.
Lock your door: the ring on the pad fills like a timer (no numbers).

shots.subject: lead@51,51
shots.why: Somebody steals it right back: the Moss egg lifted from its nest.
The town hall: a scoreboard on its front.
Most eggs wins: DAX 200 on top, KIT 0 at the bottom.

shots.subject: grandma@50,48
shots.why: Grandmas play (laugh 1 builds).

shots.subject: mailman@48,30
shots.why: Mailmen play.

shots.subject: mayor@50,48
shots.why: The mayor plays in a ski mask, top hat on top (laugh 1).
One minute to midnight: eggs fly hand to hand; claw marks on the clock-tower roof (clue 2).

shots.subject: lead@50,35
shots.why: Whoever holds one at midnight is gone by morning: a kid stares at his egg.

shots.subject: kit@50,51
shots.why: Then there is Kit: eleven, never stolen anything; her base is a mat.

shots.subject: kit@42,44
shots.why: She found an egg once. She returned it: Kit sets the Geode egg back in its nest.
With a sorry note: the folded note reads SORRY.
Her score is zero: Dax vaults a fence, the scoreboard behind.

shots.subject: dax@50,30
shots.why: Her big brother Dax, number one, arms full of eggs.

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: He calls her the slowest thief alive.

shots.subject: kit@50,50
shots.why: She just keeps saying excuse me: Kit waits politely behind a queue of thieves.

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: But Kit notices things: she looks up.
Nests everywhere, an empty sky; the hall weathervane is a dragon (clue 1); AFK frozen by a wall (cameo 1).
The eggs are cold, always cold: the Plain egg in Kit's still hands (clue 3, spoken).

shots.subject: kit@50,34
shots.why: Unless you stand very still: the egg warms from blue to gold and lights her face.

shots.subject: kit@50,47
shots.why: Nobody else stands still long enough: runners streak past the one still girl.

shots.subject: dax@50,37
shots.why: One night, Dax got greedy: one more egg, arms full, the clock behind him.
The clock struck twelve; a shadow covers the moon (he is never shown taken).
In the morning, his bed was empty.
One feather on his pillow, bigger than Kit.

shots.subject: kit@56,40
shots.why: So that night, Kit did the unthinkable: she tiptoes to the nest nobody wanted.

shots.subject: kit@50,51
shots.why: She was terrible at it; she apologizes to the nest (small laugh).

shots.subject: kit@50,45
shots.why: She walks to the middle of town and stops; the town gathers in a ring.

shots.subject: lead@50,51
shots.why: One minute to midnight. Everyone points, mouths open: drop it! (no bubbles)

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: Kit held on: the egg under her chin lights her face gold. The narration slows.
The bell rings twelve; the shadow comes down; wings fill the frame edge to edge.
Its wings are as wide as the street; the mother lowers her head to Kit.

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: It was not a bird. It was a dragon. (the twist: the crowd gasps)
Very, very gently, it lifts Kit into the clouds.
Money shot: a nest the size of the town, kids with sleeping baby dragons in golden light.

shots.subject: dax@50,49
shots.why: Every missing kid was in it. Even Dax, a hatchling asleep on his head.

shots.subject: little@50,35
shots.why: Each one had a baby dragon asleep in their lap.

shots.subject: kit@50,48
shots.why: Eggs only hatch if you hold them still through midnight: Kit, still, the egg gold.
A hundred years of stealing: not one had ever hatched. The camera rises over the nest.

shots.subject: kit@50,35
shots.why: Kit's egg cracked: the only gold dragon in the nest sneezes a spark on her (laugh 3).
She was never taking thieves. She was taking babysitters: the mother curled around them all.
Dax came home the next morning, on a dragon: dragons land in the square at sunrise.
That night nobody played hot potato: an egg left on a bench; AFK, still frozen, a hatchling asleep on his head (cameo 2).
The scoreboard got a new word: HATCHED. Kit is number one.
The first line again, flipped: the same drone, the town sitting still, eggs glowing gold in every lap.
